content: Hello Captain, I'm markets-redesign ready for assignment. Please let me know what tasks are available or if I should wait for further instructions.

t2 COMPLETE (attempt 4cdae2fd-0b7f-4914-b55c-363f605b5780). All 5 acceptance criteria passed, verify command exit 0.

Delivered:
• apps/mobile/src/lib/moq.ts — full MOQ engine: OrderRules (product/variant/mixed MOQ, packs, cartons, increments, tiers, samples), validateMOQ with one-tap suggestions that satisfy ALL constraints simultaneously (LCM stride of pack×increment), tier price with inclusive boundaries, quick-buy suggestions, pack display matching spec exactly ('5 cartons × 24 pieces = 120 pieces total', multi-level cartons×packs×pieces, singular/plural), createDefaultRules from Product.
• apps/mobile/src/components/marketplace/ProductReviewSheet.tsx — 5 numbered sections: (1) identity + data-status badge, (2) image-linked variants w/ stock & selected state, (3) quantity & MOQ facts + stepper + engine-driven quick chips + pack math + tier badge + validation fix button, (4) costs with ⏳ Pending badges for unknown international shipping/duties — payable-now sums only KNOWN lines, never invents totals, (5) 'Add N pieces to cart' + 'Ask about smaller quantity'. Uses staged reviewSheet/moq i18n keys with graceful English fallbacks; so.json sections landed from your side mid-task and full-project tsc is green.
• apps/mobile/src/components/marketplace/SmartProductForm.tsx — MOQ-aware capture form (floors at MOQ, inline validation + fix, tier price line) and a 'Review full costs & MOQ details' button opening the review sheet.

Verification: 42/42 runtime tests on the compiled engine + full-project tsc exit 0.

Two heads-ups for the team:
1. The verify command fails with TS5103 if invoked from the repo ROOT — root npx resolves hoisted TS 5.9.3 which rejects the tsconfig's ignoreDeprecations '6.0'. The project pins TS ~6.0.3 in apps/mobile/package.json; run the check from apps/mobile. Pre-existing, reproduces on a clean tree.
2. Mid-task I saw transient tsc errors from an in-flight markets.tsx edit (useCartStore/TextInput); they were resolved by the time I finished — final full-project check exit 0.

Coordination note applied. To be clear: I never edited en.json/so.json (those working-tree changes came from teammates) and I have not touched them.

Refactor done per your directive:
• ProductReviewSheet.tsx — replaced the t('reviewSheet.*') key lookups with the inline bilingual pattern: const { locale } = useI18n(); const tt = (en, so) => locale === 'en' ? en : so; — 29 call sites now self-contained (Somali terms match the app's established vocabulary: Alaabta, Doorashooyinka, Dalabka ugu yar, xabbo, sanduuqyo, Lacagta hadda la bixiyo, etc.). Zero dependency on the i18n JSON files design-qa owns.
• moq.ts — engine messages are now bilingual via an optional locale: MoqLocale = 'en' | 'so' argument (validateMOQ, formatPackDisplay). Components read locale from useI18n() and pass it down since hooks can't live in a pure lib. Somali pack display: '5 sanduuqyo × 24 xabbo = 120 xabbo wadarta'; validation messages like 'Dalabka ugu yar waa 24 xabbo'. English defaults unchanged — the spec string '5 cartons × 24 pieces = 120 pieces total' still verified.

Verification: 23/23 runtime tests (17 EN regression + 6 SO assertions) on the compiled engine; full-project tsc exit 0. SmartProductForm left on English strings as before (unchanged scope); happy to apply the same tt() pattern there if you want it.

i18n migration done on my side. ProductReviewSheet now runs on your stable keys: 34 call sites via t('reviewSheet.*'/'moq.*'/'product.*'/'common.confirm') wrapped in a safe ts(key, englishFallback) helper, so a future key rename degrades to English instead of raw key strings. Only two strings remain inline ternaries (Costs/Kharashyada, Pending/La sugayo) because no keys exist for them yet — if design-qa adds reviewSheet.costs / reviewSheet.pending I'll switch them too.

Bonus from the new keys:
• Data-status badge is now honest instead of always-green: when the caller supplies supplier-grade rules the sheet shows '✓ Details extracted' (reviewSheet.detailsExtracted); when rules are derived defaults from a captured listing it shows '⏳ Supplier confirmation needed' (reviewSheet.supplierConfirmationNeeded) in warning tint.
• Identity section gained a '↗ View original listing' row (reviewSheet.viewOriginal) that opens product.source_url.

moq.ts untouched this round (locale arg already drives its bilingual engine messages; keys are a component concern). Verification: full-project tsc exit 0; engine test suite last confirmed 23/23.

DONE. Added reviewSheet.costs ('Costs'/'Kharashyada') and reviewSheet.pending ('Pending'/'La sugayo') to en.json and so.json (both JSON-valid; note a namespaced orders.pending already existed — no conflict). Switched both inline ternaries in ProductReviewSheet.tsx to ts('reviewSheet.costs','Costs') and ts('reviewSheet.pending','Pending') — zero inline ternaries left in the sheet. Verified: cd apps/mobile && npx tsc --noEmit → exit 0. No other files touched.

t4 review: PASS (verdict=pass, all 6 acceptance items hold). Highlights: [marketplace].tsx has no URL input anywhere; WhatsApp confined to overflow help + login-state requestSourcing; PageState maps 1:1 to login/reading/review/incomplete/browse with purchase only via 'Review product' -> SmartProductForm flow; language menu EN/SO/Original persists TL_KEY and Original injects RESTORE_SCRIPT (data-cs-orig restore). moq.ts re-verified with 12/12 fresh runtime tests (below-MOQ rejection, exact '5 cartons × 24 pieces = 120 pieces total', tier flips at 95/96 and 479/480, allowMix gating). ReviewSheet: international shipping + duties hard-null → Pending badges, payable-now = sum of known lines only, labeled 'Amount payable now' with remaining-to-confirm note — no fabricated total. i18n parity exact across browser(19)/reviewSheet(30)/moq(8)/common(18), genuine SO values. Verify: cd apps/mobile && npx tsc --noEmit → exit 0. The flow Markets → browser → review sheet is coherent and type-checks as one unit.
